intuition: Expand a window until it contains all required character counts, then shrink its left edge while it remains valid.

brute_force.approach: Enumerate substrings, count their characters, and keep the shortest substring covering every required count.

optimal.approach: Track required and current counts plus how many distinct requirements are satisfied. Expand right, then contract left while all requirements remain satisfied.

edge_cases: An empty target needs no characters, so return the empty string.
If the source is shorter than the target or lacks a required multiplicity, no window exists.
Repeated characters in the target require matching counts, not just presence.
